statement: A nonlinear positive-real cocycle turns weighted Wiener atom detection into the exact zeta-ratio multiplicity slope; the linear Herglotz term contributes energy at infinity while continuous boundary measure contributes none at first order.
compatible_assumptions: Compensated positive Herglotz measure with finite integral(1+gamma²)^-1dmu; fixedPoissoncenterx>0. For xi, RH is needed separately to identify the atomic positive representation and a0.
already_proved: Full scalar slope with noninteger atom masses, singular continuous measures and infinite total mass. Two different proofs and Gaussian/Lebesgue controls independently checked.
conjectural_or_unresolved: Exact nonlinear-formula priority; quantitative remainders for diffuse/fractal measures and growing centers. No independent positivity proof for actual xi is supplied.
next_precise_step: Give effective remainder under a stated modulus of atom concentration, then verify a natural arithmetic approximation meets it; search exact Hardy/Herglotz antecedents.
potential_counterexamples: exp(w²) has nonzero infinity energy despite no zeros. No unrestricted C_b test-convergence assertion is made when Gaussian energy escapes; tests need behavior at infinity. Total-variation convergence to a nonzero atomic limit is impossible for the absolutely continuous epsilon-energy measures.
tests: Exact beta profiles, two linear autocorrelation/Wiener normalizations, uniform continuous and infinite-Lebesgue sanity controls; numerical agreement is not used as proof.
significance: Reusable analytic identity and exact structural explanation of a multiplicity norm; priority unassessed, no RH progress claim.
difficulty: Ordinary harmonic analysis once the compensated tail and boundary limits are treated correctly; effective uniform arithmetic application remains difficult.

statement: Growing local zero density makes a natural xi-weighted Hardy translation compact, but gamma/product growth then removes every spectral eigenvalue: the actual generator has empty spectrum, while zeros appear in boundary orbit energy and domain obstructions.
compatible_assumptions: RH, ordinary right-half-plane Hardy space, the exact cocycle F(w)/F(w+tau), maximal C0 generator domain. These are not interchangeable with de Branges or other proposed spectral spaces.
already_proved: Contraction, strong continuity, positive-time compactness/injectivity/quasinilpotence, entire generator resolvent, and exact kernel nondifferentiability coefficient.
conjectural_or_unresolved: Historical priority and whether a different explicitly defined Hilbert-space realization can have a meaningful nonempty self-adjoint spectrum with the arithmetic trace formula.
next_precise_step: For one proposed replacement space state its norm and domain, prove closed self-adjointness and a genuine zero-count/trace identity; compare the current empty-spectrum control before asserting zero eigenvalues.
potential_counterexamples: Unweighted translation is noncompact; a finite polynomial imaginary-zero product need not have the growing-density compactness input. A formal differential expression does not specify a generator domain.
tests: Boundary-window product decay, finite-output Hilbert–Schmidt cutoff, iterated-eigenfunction contradiction and direct all-lambda resolvent identities are analytic checks; no zeta numerics establish RH.
significance: Precise negative knowledge for one spectral construction and a positive link to the energy identity, not a blanket obstruction to Hilbert–Polya.
difficulty: Self-contained given standard Hardy/product/counting inputs; constructing a useful alternative arithmetic operator is much harder.
